protocol.scope: Separate exploratory learning experiment; settings recorded before execution. Not a reproduction of the 51-dataset benchmark or final IEEE paper.
protocol.split_policy: Split the saved 397 training rows into 318 fit / 79 inner-stop rows, stratified. Reuse the saved 86 validation rows for exploratory evaluation only. The prior 86 learning-test rows are excluded from all transforms, fitting and scoring in this experiment.
protocol.design: One fixed layout and three independently seeded layouts per stochastic method. Cross every layout with the same three CNN seeds: 21 fitted models. Do not select the best layout or seed.
protocol.preprocessing: Use the upstream transformer scaler fit on the 318 fit rows, verify against a common training-only MinMaxScaler. No clipping or uint8 quantization for CNN input; one-channel float32. Fixed uses the identical scaler. All layouts preserve 30 features.
protocol.cnn_architecture: Reuse Experiment 02 SmallGridCNN (1282 parameters). Select minimum inner-stop cross-entropy; never use evaluation rows for fitting or checkpoint selection.
layout_metrics: mean Manhattan distance of same-measurement mean/SE/worst pairs

layout_null.purpose: Descriptive random-permutation reference, not a corrected hypothesis test. Similarity is measured on the same fit profiles that SOM optimizes, not independent validation of biological meaning.

protocol.encoding_audit: On evaluation inputs only, compare the upstream default uint8 conversion, clipped uint8, and float32. Save actual altered feature values and a synthetic 1.02 demonstration; do not train extra quantized models or claim predictive consequences.
limits: One small, previously studied dataset and one split
The 86 evaluation rows have been inspected in earlier exercises and are not a new sealed holdout
Seed runs are dependent, not independent datasets or confidence intervals
Neither neighborhood similarity nor prediction proves explanation quality
No genomic, causal, clinical or novelty claim
No new attribution experiment in this milestone

encoding_audit.note: Numerical input audit only; not an estimate of classifier performance impact.
